questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to teach punctuation and grammar to young children
The history of the apostrophe in the Greek language
Why apostrophes are misused, and a group that defended them
How texting and social media have made people better writers
questions.why: They discuss the misuse of apostrophes and The Apostrophe Protection Society closing.

questions.q: What annoys Rob about some taxi signs?
options: They use an apostrophe to show a plural
They are too small to read
They spell 'taxi' without the letter i
They have no punctuation at all
questions.why: Rob gets angry at 'taxi's' because the apostrophe isn't used to show there is more than one.

questions.q: Is Rob really 'chilled out' about punctuation?
options: Yes, he never notices mistakes
No, he admits it bothers him, though he wishes it didn't
Yes, because he thinks punctuation doesn't matter
No, and he corrects everyone he meets
questions.why: He says, 'OK, I'm not chilled at all. But maybe I wish I were.'

questions.q: Why does Rob say correct punctuation matters in CVs and job applications?
options: Employers use computers to check it before reading
It makes the application shorter and easier to read
It is required by law for all official documents
Mistakes could cost you a good job opportunity
questions.why: He says a good standard is expected and if you get it wrong you could miss out.

questions.q: What has The Apostrophe Protection Society done for nearly 20 years?
options: Written punctuation textbooks for schools
Pointed out mistakes on public signs and in communications
Campaigned to remove the apostrophe from English
Given prizes to good writers
questions.why: Georgina says they publicly pointed out incorrect use in public signs and communications.

questions.q: Why is John Edwards giving up the society?
options: He has run out of money to keep the society going
Younger members have taken over and changed its aims
His age, and a belief that texting and social media won
He now thinks apostrophes are no longer necessary
questions.why: It is partly his age and partly because he thinks he lost the battle due to texting and social media.

questions.q: According to John Edwards, why do people misuse apostrophes?
options: They don't know the rules and won't learn them
Schools no longer teach punctuation
Phones correct the words automatically
The rules keep changing
questions.why: He blames 'a mixture of ignorance and laziness'.

questions.q: What does Rob suggest by saying, “and you thought I was a pedant!”?
options: He agrees John Edwards is completely right
He thinks John Edwards is not strict enough
He is annoyed that Georgina called him rude
John Edwards holds even stronger views than he does
questions.why: He says it after hearing Edwards' 'quite strong views' about barbarians winning.
